author: Glitchaye
body:
Woops, sorry for the archive xD


Hey guys, glitchy1 here, and what you're seeing above is just a small picture I whipped up for a suggestion I have for the forums.

As you can see, it says "Comparing Sunrise728 with izjust4fun" And that's what I'm proposing to you, the community. This system i'm proposing will compare ALL stats between 2 players of your choosing, besides K/D & Time Played

Beside the gamemode names, such as nebula and nexus, will be icons representing each gamemode (Bow for elim, Diamond sword for nexus) And beside the 'Kills' and 'Deaths' will be a sword and skull, respectively.

The picture isnt the greatest thing ever, but it's a rough explanation of what I wanted to show you.

If you have any suggestions, feel free to tell me!

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
Ooh, that sounds pretty cool :3
I don't like to be competitive too much, but I think this would be great for the people who do (:
I think a cool feature would be to have percentages of how much you're beating or losing to the other person. Say I've gotten 8 monuments and Netox has gotten 20. Then, on my chart, it would say 8 monuments (40%) because 8 is 40% of 20. This would work with all gamemodes and I think it would be a cool, specific way to see how much experience you have relative to the other people :3
